subject: Engineering Onboarding — New Hires
body:
Welcome new engineers! Start with docs/engineering-onboarding.md and docs/engineering-runbook.md. Key people: Raj Patel (CTO), Priya Sharma (EM), Kenji Nakamura (Security), Diana Chen (DB), Arjun Mehta (Payments), Riya Desai (Search). Ask in #engineering.
